_doc: LEVER 3 -- catastrophe cap + per-trade loss tail. Run per frozen prereg analysis/recommendations/prereg-lever-catcap-2026-08-06.json (commit 089beb50).

verdict.axis_A_catcap: GRAVEYARD_COLLISION -- for a stop_mode==structure position the catastrophe cap IS ExitState.premium_stop_pct (exit_manager.py:224-225,237), so tightening it is the graveyarded stop-tightening item; AND it was already varied by catastrophe_stop_shakeout_ab.py (2026-07-23, cells -0.70/-0.99) and stopped_then_paid_2026_08_04.py (cells -0.10..-0.50). Additionally refuted in the requested direction: Wed +$542.70 vs Thu -$1,698.00.
verdict.axis_B_giveback: NULL -- new sub-knob (pre-TP1 trail WIDTH, never varied) but strictly dominated by the hard-coded BE floor it cannot be separated from; runner anchor -$8,060..-$8,397, WORSE than the already-graveyarded E1 cell (-$7,758.85).
verdict.axis_C_befloor: GRAVEYARD_COLLISION -- 5th iteration of a 4-times-dead cell (pretp1-be-floor-isolated-ab-2026-08-02). New cells 0.15/0.20/0.25 sit on the worse side of the published monotone, as pre-registered, and are worse.
verdict.axis_D_tp1: NULL -- fails the HARD Tuesday gate on every cell (-$2,906 to -$3,821). Best Wednesday saver in the study (+$1,683) but unaffordable.

replication_checks.source: LOSS-ANATOMY-2026-08-06 sibling-fill substitution vs this run walk_exit_manager tp1=0.5

mechanical_identity_proof.claim: In structure mode stop_pct = cat_pct and is stored in ExitState.premium_stop_pct; the shape own premium_stop_pct is discarded. plan_exit_actions line 440 tests worst_premium <= runner_stop against that single field. Therefore catastrophe_stop_pct and premium_stop_pct are the SAME operative knob for every ribbon_ride position.

per_trade_tail_invariance.finding: The maximum single-trade loss does not move by one cent under any exit knob at any setting. Corroborates LOSS-ANATOMY-2026-08-06 from the opposite direction: the loss lives at the DAY level, not the trade level.
